_what_this_is: pre-defined agent roles with PUBLISHED keypairs, so a fresh session can assume a role by retrieval alone. A role is a costume, not an identity: the register can say what the role may do (its mandate) and can never say who wore it.
assume_with_openssl: openssl dgst -sha256 -sign private/sign.pem <file>  # emits DER; convert to raw r||s for registry statements
assume_with_sgit: fetch (or clone) the role's keystore/ directory
sgit pki sign <file> --fingerprint <ENCRYPTION fingerprint — bundle.fingerprint, the keystore's address>  # passphrase: see keystore/PASSPHRASE.txt

roles.definition: maintains a published site under mandate: reads the repo, opens pull requests, never pushes to the release branch
the referee of a write path: drains an inbox, applies published policy, commits what passes — the runbook is a policy document
a third party answering 'may agent X do Y right now?' from public records and signature checks alone
curates a corpus: locates sources, tiers them for publication, keeps the manifest that says what is where
